svg.title: From genes to cell function: a simplified diagram
svg.desc: Four illustrated stages from DNA to RNA, protein and cell function. A simplified conceptual pathway, not an autism diagnostic test.
svg.text: From genes to cell function: a simplified diagram

text.tspan: This simplified pathway applies to protein-coding genes. Cells have other mechanisms
that regulate gene activity. Not all genes code for proteins, and not all changes
in gene activity are related to autism.
